decisionTiming: Specified before inspecting pass-2 prediction scores. Pass 2 already collected; this is retrospective held-out replay for B, not a model deployed during its collection.
input: Same background-subtracted Bx, By, Bz in microtesla and causal 0.12s component median as A; no tip coordinate, guide, elapsed movement time, pose label, or Pencil IMU input.
prototypesPerPlacement: Four: trimmed whole-hold median plus the three already-defined causal windows. Each uses training-only row before/after linear background correction at its timestamp.
positionDistance: Minimum Euclidean magnetic distance among all retained prototypes for that target. Repeated targets do not receive extra votes.
localRule: Select at most four distinct targets within 7.5mm of the best magnetic target, then average their XY by inverse squared magnetic distance. Exact matches average only exact local matches.
qualityRules: Nearest-prototype distance <= max(3uT,5*max training hold noise); signal >= max(3uT,0.2*minimum prototype magnitude). Reject if another target >=0.2 normalized XY away has magnetic distance within 0.75uT of best. Still log all candidate errors.
evaluation: Freeze B1 built only from pass 1; compare A1 and B1 on exactly the same pass-2 observations and causal frames. Save before building A12/B12. No score-driven tuning on pass 2 in this implementation.
limits: Three causal windows are correlated, not extra independent placements. Local averaging may bias grid edges inward. Data contain only naturally occurring small pose variation; arbitrary unseen tilt robustness is not established. A12/B12 have no independent test until pass 3.
